checks.detail: Baseline black video has duration ratio 0.15 (hard fail <0.75) and SSIM far below 0.70 gate, so score=0.0 via multiplicative zeroing.
SSIM, pHash, and duration metrics measure rendered video quality against reference, not the algorithmic approach; anti-cheat gates use generous 5x margins with floors.
Multiplicative aggregation prevents gaming any single easy dimension (duration is easiest but contributes zero if SSIM or pHash fail).
Empty/black/random videos fail the SSIM 0.70 gate; reference video is excluded from pristine restore and source-level grep blocks file I/O; data-dump approaches blocked by literal/array/string gates.
compute_reward.py accepts CLI args for agent video and source paths, reads saved artifacts, and can be re-run independently without agent execution.
All code paths (fail_reward, gate failures, normal scoring) write valid reward.json with score, subscores list, and optional additional_data; reward.txt always written.

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three visual similarity factors must be high for a non-trivial score, preventing gaming of any single dimension.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search, gated at 0.70 with cubic scaling

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame perceptual hash (pHash) Hamming distance normalized to [0,1]

components.name: duration_penalty
components.metric: Frame count ratio between agent and reference video
components.gate: hard fail outside [0.75, 1.25] ratio, linear ramp within

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Requires actual pixel-level visual similarity above 0.70 gate with cubic scaling making near-perfect match needed for high scores

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Perceptual hash catches structural/layout differences; correlated with SSIM but independently validates visual structure

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Matching frame count is straightforward but cannot carry score alone due to multiplicative aggregation
